recordings.lineage: LINEAGE: SD Card > Computer hard drive > Reaper (Mix the 2 sources, Izotope RX7 De-Click plugin to remove some of the louder clapping, MAutoAlign, Volume Envelope to raise the levels on the encore which was not as loud, ReEQ EQ, ReaComp with NY Comp preset and 50% Wet/Dry, LoudMax limiting, render to Flac 24/96) > Foobar2000 (tagging).  NOTES: The AKG C 460 B with CK8 shotguns account for most of the mix on this one with the Schoeps brought in at a lower level to fill out the sound just a bit. W
recordings.rank_reason: most complete (42 songs; next best 38); matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); lineage documented
recordings.source: SOURCE 1: AKG C 460 B > CK8 shotgun capsules (aimed at the stacks) > EAA-PSP2 > Sound Devices MixPre 6II.   SOURCE 2: Schoeps MK41 hyper capsules (DINA) > NBob cables > PFA > EAA-PSP2 > Sound Devices MixPre 6II.   Both sets of mics run on the same stand 10' tall at the front left corner of the soundboard booth into the same MixPre at 32/96.
